content_type.description: MIME type returned by the Pinterest media server.
content_type.title: Content Type

download_url.description: Direct public URL to download the stored file.
download_url.title: Download URL

duration_ms.description: Duration of the downloaded video in milliseconds.
duration_ms.title: Video Duration (ms)

file_sha256.description: SHA-256 checksum of the stored file.
file_sha256.title: SHA-256

file_size_bytes.description: Size of the stored file in bytes.
file_size_bytes.title: File Size (bytes)

key_value_store_key.description: Record key in the run's Key-Value Store.
key_value_store_key.title: Key-Value Store Key

media_height.description: Pixel height of the downloaded file.
media_height.title: Height

media_width.description: Pixel width of the downloaded file.

pin_id.description: Pinterest Pin ID. Search rows can use an opaque Pinterest ID.

saved_as.description: Filename of the media file in the Key-Value Store.

scraped_at.description: ISO timestamp when the record was produced.

selected_variant.description: Pinterest image size or video quality selected from the input preference.

thumbnail_url.description: Public poster image for a video Pin.
